memory.summary:
On December 13th, Andy discusses the AI project with various individuals. He meets Samantha at school during lunchtime and proposes a meeting with Leo, Caroline, Diego, and Diego's suggestion of a meeting at the park around 2 PM for street tacos and noise-cancelling headphones instead of Caroline's Café. Andy speaks with Leo at home planning to meet at Caroline's Café the following day at 1 PM (beforehand having coffee together around noon). They decide to make it a double date for their ideas, but Andy also meets Mei at the theater and invites her for a coffee meeting at 1 PM the next day.

Later, Andy encounters Peter at the hospital around 7 PM that same day. Peter has had a last-minute meeting with Noor at the museum and reschedules their meeting at Caroline's Café for tomorrow at 3 PM instead of 4 PM. Andy proposes a collaborative discussion to which Peter agrees, suggesting they meet at the old oak tree by 4 PM before grabbing some vegan street tacos as usual. On December 14th, Noor suggests rescheduling their meeting with Diego for Wednesday next week at 2 PM to avoid conflicting with other meetings, and Andy agrees.
